name: Git + GitHub CLI
description: Installs git and the GitHub CLI (gh) into the workspace, survives restarts, and provides a settings panel for gh login (token stored in the zero-knowledge secret store).

auth_method.description: How to log into gh: OAuth Device Flow (Sign in with GitHub, no token needed), paste a personal access token, or run the interactive `gh auth login` web flow (TUI only, not usable from the web UI).

oauth_client_id.description: GitHub OAuth App client_id used for the Device Flow login (public value, device flow needs no client_secret; the OAuth App must have Device Flow enabled). Defaults to aw-app-git's own public OAuth App so 'Sign in with GitHub' works out of the box — only override this if you want to use your own OAuth App. Falls back to the AW_APP_GIT_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID env var, then this default, when unset.

github_token.description: GitHub personal access token (scopes: repo, read:org). Used for `gh auth login --with-token` when auth_method=token. Never stored in plain config — routed to the zero-knowledge secret store.

watchdog_enabled.description: Watch the workspace's repos and notify (persistent notification) when a repo has uncommitted changes.

watchdog_interval_s.description: How often (seconds) the uncommitted-changes watchdog re-scans the workspace's repos. Minimum 30s.
